target_source_hash.method: recreated capped-at-two typed-source-row manifest from retained d02 source/bar rows and canonical JSON

independent_mechanics.method: raw SQL window arithmetic using cumulative sum(log(split_factor)), adjusted_close=close*cumulative_factor, adjusted_volume=volume/cumulative_factor, exact lag horizons, identity/action guards, and prior-20 adjusted-volume mean

expected_population_boundary.daily_source_series_semantics: broad retained source-ticker census, not an accepted selected-company denominator
expected_population_boundary.limitation: The daily batch covers 42 target dates, while current dated-instrument evidence covers only 9 dates and the latest date is partial; therefore the batch is not proof of the full selected-instrument/temporal expected population.

sql_evidence: count/min/max/distinct and duplicate-key aggregates over daily_shared_series_v1, daily_shared_input_v1, and daily_shared_value_v1 for the exact run_id
sha256(string_agg(series_no||':'||encode(input_or_output_sha256,'hex'), E'\n' order by series_no)) recomputed for every daily_shared_batch_v1 row
sha256(convert_to(canonical_jsonb::text,'UTF8')) recomputed for every input and output row; seven disjoint series ranges cover 1..13044
source_record_sha256 reconstructed from d02_daily_source_v2 and capped ordered d02_daily_bar_v2 typed-row hashes
raw window arithmetic across all 388 series having a nonunit split or unknown action; no producer function or checker invocation
per-date counts and left join of ref01_practical_dated_instrument_v3.ticker to daily_shared_series_v1.source_ticker
acceptance_boundary: This review approves only exact batch completeness, hash linkage, and tested arithmetic/null mechanics. It does not accept the daily family, source/identity/action semantics, regular-session basis, or the selected-instrument full-period population.

claim_release.reason: All assigned structural, manifest, canonical row-hash, retained-source linkage, and independent mechanics checks completed with zero discrepancies; the unresolved source, identity, action, regular-session, and expected-population questions are explicitly preserved rather than misclassified as failed batch effects.

required_work: Adjudicate 201082 nonexact-source rows and 496067 null-identity rows from retained evidence only.
Validate regular-session close, volume, dollar-volume, and action-source limits without calling providers.
Consume the progressing full-period dated-instrument manifest, while refusing to certify the partial 2026-08-01 through 2026-08-09 state.
Emit exact retained evidence, or one typed source successor requiring separate admission when retained evidence is insufficient.

rejection_conditions: Reject any variant that grants HTTP, provider-call, or source-byte admission.
Reject any variant that treats the partial dated-instrument manifest as full-period proof.
Reject any variant that performs production code integration or family acceptance.
Reject any variant that resets counters, changes owner/fence/stop/scope/deadline, or creates more than one successor assignment.
